purpose: Compare the historical Point_data pickle serialization contract with public JAX source snapshots near and before the artifact date.

public_jax_snapshots.relationship: The public JAX source on the same calendar date exposes the same private reconstruction callable and the same weak_type-only aval state shape seen in the historical pickle.
The same serialization contract is present in a pre-artifact JAX source snapshot.

proven: The historical pickle uses the same JAX private reconstruction callable and weak_type-only aval-state contract exposed by public JAX source snapshots immediately before and on the artifact date.
This makes the historical JAX serialization format directly compatible with JAX source that existed before the Point_data ingest.
not_proven: The exact JAX release/version used on the author's machine is not identified.
The exact December 2025 producer code remains unresolved.
Format compatibility does not establish that the cited JAX commit was the runtime used to create the artifact.
